scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @decision-pipeline/web" "npm run dev -w @decision-pipeline/api" ".venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --app-dir apps/ai --port 8001"
